lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਦੋਊ ਸਮਾਨੇ ਮਸਤਕੁ ਡਾਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਗਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: maan abhimaan dooo samaane masatak daar gur paagio ||
lines.translation: Honor and dishonor are the same to me; I have placed my forehead upon the Guru's Feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਪਤ ਹਰਖੁ ਨ ਆਪਤ ਦੂਖਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੈ ਲਾਗਿਓ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)pat harakh na aapat dookhaa ra(n)g thaakurai laagio ||1||
lines.translation: Wealth does not excite me, and misfortune does not disturb me; I have embraced love for my Lord and Master. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਸ ਬਾਸਰੀ ਏਕੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਗਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: baas baasaree ekai suaamee udiaan drisataagio ||
lines.translation: The One Lord and Master dwells in the home; He is seen in the wilderness as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਸੰਤ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਡਾਰਿਓ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਰਬਾਗਿਓ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: nirabhau bhae sa(n)t bhram daario pooran sarabaagio ||2||
lines.translation: I have become fearless; the Saint has removed my doubts. The All-knowing Lord is pervading everywhere. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਤੈ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਮਨਿ ਬੁਰੋ ਨ ਲਾਗਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo kichh karatai kaaran keeno man buro na laagio ||
lines.translation: Whatever the Creator does, my mind is not troubled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਸੋਇਓ ਮਨੁ ਜਾਗਿਓ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat parasaad sa(n)tan kai soio man jaagio ||3||
lines.translation: By the Grace of the Saints and the Company of the Holy, my sleeping mind has been awakened. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਓੜਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ ਪਰਿਓ ਆਇਓ ਸਰਣਾਗਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak oR tuhaaree pario aaio saranaagio ||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak seeks Your Support; he has come to Your Sanctuary.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗ ਸਹਜ ਰਸ ਮਾਣੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗਿਓ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੬੦॥
lines.transliteration: naam ra(n)g sahaj ras maane phir dookh na laagio ||4||2||160||
lines.translation: In the Love of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he enjoys intuitive peace; pain no longer touches him. ||4||2||160||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਲਾ₂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee maalaa₂ mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Gauree Maalaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਇਆ ਲਾਲੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: paaiaa laal ratan man paaiaa ||
lines.translation: I have found the jewel of my Beloved within my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਥੀਆ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tan seetal man seetal theeaa satagur sabad samaaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: My body is cooled, my mind is cooled and soothed, and I am absorbed into the Shabad, the Word of the True Guru. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਥੀ ਭੂਖ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਸਭ ਲਾਥੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਸਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: laathee bhookh trisan sabh laathee chi(n)taa sagal bisaaree ||
lines.translation: My hunger has departed, my thirst has totally departed, and all my anxiety is forgotten.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਧਰਿਓ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਤੋ ਜਗੁ ਸਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kar masatak gur poorai dhario man jeeto jag saaree ||1||
lines.translation: The Perfect Guru has placed His Hand upon my forehead; conquering my mind, I have conquered the whole world. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਇ ਰਹੇ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਡੋਲਨ ਤੇ ਅਬ ਚੂਕੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tripat aghaai rahe rid a(n)tar dolan te ab chooke ||
lines.translation: Satisfied and satiated, I remain steady within my heart, and now, I do not waver at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਖੁਟੁ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਤੋਟਿ ਨਹੀ ਰੇ ਮੂਕੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: akhut khajaanaa satigur deeaa tot nahee re mooke ||2||
lines.translation: The True Guru has given me the inexhaustible treasure; it never decreases, and never runs out. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਚਰਜੁ ਏਕੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਿ ਐਸੀ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: acharaj ek sunahu re bhaaee gur aisee boojh bujhaaee ||
lines.translation: Listen to this wonder, O Siblings of Destiny: the Guru has given me this understanding.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਹਿ ਪਰਦਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਜਉ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਤਉ ਬਿਸਰੀ ਤਾਤਿ ਪਰਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: laahi paradaa thaakur jau bhetio tau bisaree taat paraaee ||3||
lines.translation: I threw off the veil of illusion, when I met my Lord and Master; then, I forgot my jealousy of others. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਏਹੁ ਅਚੰਭਉ ਸੋ ਜਾਨੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਚਾਖਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahio na jaaee ehu acha(n)bhau so jaanai jin chaakhiaa ||
lines.translation: This is a wonder which cannot be described. They alone know it, who have tasted it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚ ਭਏ ਬਿਗਾਸਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਲੈ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੬੧॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak sach bhae bigaasaa gur nidhaan ridai lai raakhiaa ||4||3||161||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, the Truth has been revealed to me. The Guru has given me the treasure; I have taken it and enshrined it within my heart. ||4||3||161||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਲਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee maalaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Gauree Maalaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਬਰਤ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ubarat raajaa raam kee saranee ||
lines.translation: Those who take to the Sanctuary of the Lord, the King, are saved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਲੋਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਮੰਡਲ ਗਿਰਿ ਗਿਰਿ ਪਰਤੇ ਧਰਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarab lok maaiaa ke ma(n)dal gir gir parate dharanee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: All other people, in the mansion of Maya, fall flat on their faces on the ground. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਤ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ਮਹਾ ਪੁਰਖਨ ਇਉ ਕਹਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: saasat si(n)mrit bed beechaare mahaa purakhan iu kahiaa ||
lines.translation: The great men have studied the Shaastras, the Simritees and the Vedas, and they have said this:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਸੂਖੁ ਨ ਕਿਨਹੂੰ ਲਹਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bin har bhajan naahee nisataaraa sookh na kinahoo(n) lahiaa ||1||
lines.translation: "Without the Lord's meditation, there is no emancipation, and no one has ever found peace." ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੀਨਿ ਭਵਨ ਕੀ ਲਖਮੀ ਜੋਰੀ ਬੂਝਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਲਹਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: teen bhavan kee lakhamee joree boojhat naahee lahare ||
lines.translation: People may accumulate the wealth of the three worlds, but the waves of greed are still not subdued.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਹਾ ਥਿਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਫਿਰਤੋ ਪਹਰੇ ਪਹਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: bin har bhagat kahaa thit paavai phirato pahare pahare ||2||
lines.translation: Without devotional worship of the Lord, where can anyone find stability? People wander around endlessly. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਿਲਾਸ ਕਰਤ ਮਨ ਮੋਹਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਤ ਨ ਕਾਮਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: anik bilaas karat man mohan pooran hot na kaamaa ||
lines.translation: People engage in all sorts of mind-enticing pastimes, but their passions are not fulfilled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲਤੋ ਜਲਤੋ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਬੂਝਤ ਸਗਲ ਬ੍ਰਿਥੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jalato jalato kabahoo na boojhat sagal brithe bin naamaa ||3||
lines.translation: They burn and burn, and are never satisfied; without the Lord's Name, it is all useless. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ ਇਹੈ ਸਾਰ ਸੁਖੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam japahu mere meetaa ihai saar sukh pooraa ||
lines.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord, my friend; this is the essence of perfect peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਾ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੬੨॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat janam maran nivaarai naanak jan kee dhooraa ||4||4||162||
lines.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, birth and death are ended. Nanak is the dust of the feet of the humble. ||4||4||162||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਲਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee maalaa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Gauree Maalaa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੋ ਸਮਝਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: mo kau ih bidh ko samajhaavai ||
lines.translation: Who can help me understand my condition?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਤਾ ਹੋਇ ਜਨਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: karataa hoi janaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Only the Creator knows it. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਜਾਨਤ ਕਿਛੁ ਇਨਹਿ ਕਮਾਨੋ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਸਾਧਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: anajaanat kichh inahi kamaano jap tap kachhoo na saadhaa ||
lines.translation: This person does things in ignorance; he does not chant in meditation, and does not perform any deep, self-disciplined meditation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਲੈ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦਉਰਾਇਓ ਕਵਨ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਬਾਧਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: dah dis lai ihu man dauraaio kavan karam kar baadhaa ||1||
lines.translation: This mind wanders around in the ten directions - how can it be restrained? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਧਨ ਭੂਮਿ ਕਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਹਉ ਇਸ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan dhan bhoom kaa thaakur hau is kaa ihu meraa ||
lines.translation: "I am the lord, the master of my mind, body, wealth and lands. These are mine."
